summary: Coca-Cola FEMSA filed a Form 6-K announcing achievement of a sustainability performance target on its sustainability-linked bonds (KOF 21L). The company reached a water use efficiency ratio of 1.26 liters per liter of beverage produced during August 2026, confirmed by an external verifier. Consequently, the interest rate for the bond period beginning September 17, 2026, will remain unchanged. This is a routine ESG/bond compliance disclosure, not a special situation. What to watch: no impact on equity holders or capital structure; purely an update on sustainability-linked debt metrics.
